rules.statement: The burden of proving the good faith of a transaction rests on the party who stands in an active confidence relationship with the donor, unless independent advice is shown.
rules.supporting_quote: "Certainly the ease of Sital Prasad v. Parbhu Lal, 3 on which the plaintiff's counsel relied in this connection, does not support any such proposition. In that case there is a specific finding that the party alleged to have used undue influence himself obtained the execution of the impugned deeds."
